LESSON: THE EARLY CHURCH

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.2: The Early Church

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Early Church. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how the early church was started, • repent their sins as guided in Acts 2:38. How was the early church started?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name the disciples of Jesus Christ,
2. describe how the early church was started,
3. desire to turn away from sins according to Acts 2:38. The learner is guided to: disciples of Jesus Christ, flash cards, word puzzle, disciples, church was started, started, How was the early church started? κς

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Early Church.
2. Explain The Early Church to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: read Matthew 10:1-4 and list the disciples of Jesus Christ,
4. Show that you can: name the disciples of Jesus Christ,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Early Church. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how the early church was started, • repent their sins as guided in Acts 2:38. How was the early church started?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Matthew 10:1-4 and list the disciples of Jesus Christ,
2. Sort the names of the 12 disciples using flash cards,
